name: The Tutors Network (editorial placeholder)
summary: Representative enrichment / tutoring category entry — compare subject specialists carefully; Singapore’s arms race is optional in year one.
body: Singapore’s tuition culture is intense. Start from your child’s actual gaps, not neighbour panic. Ask for trial lessons, curriculum alignment (IB vs IGCSE vs MOE), and clear cancellation terms. Arrival-year guidance on expat.sg: one social and one physical activity before stacking weekday enrichment. Method centres (e.g. Kumon) and private tutors both fail when commute time exceeds learning gains — trial the specific teacher near home, not the brand brochure. Families aiming for AEIS / S-AEIS should brief tutors on MOE preceding-level maths (and secondary English) method, not generic ‘exam tips’ — and keep an international-school hold until MOE placement lands.
